decision: GO for bounded native member exports only when the run binds the exact F0 split SHA, checks the ordered 468-group result, and root verifies memory/file-cache headroom
invocation_conditions: Pin the known frozen F0 split manifest SHA; source only checks equality with the caller-supplied expected SHA.
Before comparison, require result groups to equal the exact ordered 468-group F0 evaluation list; the exporter has no internal fold-0 or group-count assertion.
Root resource admission must include current file-cache/headroom because full-parquet hashing can warm page cache and final prediction hashing can repopulate about 75 MB per full panel.

resource_and_execution_scope.review_budget: static source/API inspection only; no Torch, native inference, parquet scan, GPU, fit, or full prediction read
resource_and_execution_scope.outputs: float32 memmap (groups, 20000, 2), evicted every eight groups; final output hash read may warm cache

limitations: The run command and its concrete input hashes were not part of this source-only inspection; root must verify the frozen invocation and result receipt.
F0 is exposed fitting/adaptation evidence and does not support clean cross-validation or public-transfer claims.
GO concerns export engineering only, not ensemble quality, member selection, or package promotion.
